paragraphs: RideShark sells a commute management platform that its pages call Unified Mobility, defined as integrated technology that connects people to transportation options within their community. Listed features include a transit trip planner with multimodal results, parking platform integration, dynamic and passive trip logging, a reward program, and reporting with auditable data. Solutions are grouped on the site as Government Solution, Corporate Solution and Campus Solution.

Three buyer groups are named on the homepage: Countries, States/Provinces, Municipalities; Fortune 500 Companies, Business Parks, Enterprises; and Universities, Colleges, Private Institutions. The platform is described as helping enterprise customers reduce costs, improve employee engagement and increase transportation options.

The about page states that the platform is built and customized with the features a client wants, including control over incentives, rewards, communication and content. A news item on the homepage describes a partnership with the County of Renfrew and Ontario on a winterized on-demand community transit network.

quote.text: Unified Mobility is defined as integrated technology that connects people to transportation options within their community.
